the checkpoint cites logs/head-test_equilibrium_reader_cocos_signed.log as the green signed arm (6 passed, 1 xfailed), but that log records 3 failed in 148.19 s; the green run is logs/head-test_equilibrium_reader_cocos.log, so the manifest attributes the result to the wrong artefact

a stray fragment ' over it, so the dataset carries the separatrix flux and the global scalar is gone.' sits outside any list after the closing paragraph, leaving unbalanced closing markup in the delivered evidence page

the change (int(self.homogeneous_time)) makes the zarr store serialisable but is not a sign site, and the brief admits scenario.py only for a sign site; it is a real and needed fix, recorded here because it exceeds the stated condition rather than the declared path list
